verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a payments and fleet-management product, but the evidence never documents acting on many items in one operation (for example, bulk refunds or bulk reader configuration). Locations and zones only help organize multiple readers. Refunds are described one payment at a time in the Dashboard. Automatic forwarding of stored offline payments is a sync behavior, not a user-driven bulk operation. These are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
